reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
남편하고 강아디하고 셋이 입으려고 샀어용
남편은 바람막이를 좋아하는편이라 선물 해주니 너무좋아하네요 ㅎㅎ 색감도 예쁘고 재질도 좋다며 엄청 만족해했어요! 반려인들과 함께입을수 있는 옷 자주 만들어쥬세요
reviews.content_en: I bought this for my husband, our pup, and me to wear together 😊 My husband loves windbreakers, so when I gave it to him as a gift, he was so happy!! He was really impressed with the pretty colors and good quality. Please keep making clothes that pet parents can wear together with their furry friends!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
댕댕찌와 댕파더님 커플룩으로 선물 보냈는데.. 댕파더님께서 덩치는 크지 않으신데..팔다리가 긴편이셔서~ 팔이 조금 짧다고 하시더라고요. 가슴둘레나 어깨부분은 잘 맞는듯 해요~
남자는 핑크인듯ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: I sent it as a couple look gift for Daengdaeng and Daengfather... Daengfather doesn't have a big build, but he has long limbs, so he said the sleeves were a bit short. The chest area and shoulders seem to fit well though~ The men's version seems to be pink haha

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 생각보다 얇아서... 가격대비 당황했지만 커플템으로 귀여워요
reviews.content_en: It's thinner than I expected... I was a bit shocked for the price, but it's cute as a couple item
